answers.In a sentence or two, what will it do fo: It approves or declines personal loan applications automatically, and the decision goes straight to the customer.
What information will it see or use?: Information about people — clients, applicants, staff or anyone else: names, contact details, account and financial details, CVs — anything about someone who can be identified
answers.What happens with what it produces?: acts entirely by itself, with no person involved at any point
answers.Who ends up seeing or receiving what it: Clients or customers — including people applying to us
answers.Which of these does it help decide, if a: Whether to lend to someone, or on what terms
answers.How widely will it be used?: Several teams, the whole business, or every case of a kind (e.g. all applications)
answers.What does it do when it acts?: Makes a yes-or-no decision — e.g. accepts or declines an application, signs something off
